messages:
Samir (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — Cobalt Retail (SI) is blocked on the AWS Marketplace onboarding step. They need an architecture review for their private VPC + Marketplace provisioning flow. They also requested g4dn.12xlarge which isn't in our usual Dedicated SKU list. Can we triage? cc @Lena @Riley @Noah

Lena (Solutions): Got it. Can you paste the SI's network diagram and exact ask? Main questions: PrivateLink vs VPC peering for Marketplace, KMS integration, and whether we can map g4dn-series to a recommended equivalent. Marketplace typically prefers PrivateLink for SaaS; peering adds routing/MTU stuff.

Samir (Partnerships): SI note (copied): "Customer has isolated account per environment behind TGW. Wants cross-account peering from Marketplace provisioned infra to their VPCs. Their infra team insists on g4dn.12xlarge for inference nodes. Also require customer-managed KMS for models." Link: https://internal.cobalt/diagrams/cobalt-retail-arch

Riley (Eng): g4dn is supported in principle, but our validated SKUs for Dedicated are currently p4d / a10 / g5 — g4dn isn't in our performance matrix. Main risks: KV cache memory footprint and throughput differences (NVLink vs PCIe), and kernel/network settings for peering (MTU). We should run a quick perf test on a g4dn-like instance before certifying.

Noah (Customer Success): Customer go-live target = next Tues. Business impact is high; SI is pushing for a short window to validate. If we can't commit, they may switch SIs. Can we get a weekend slot for testing?

Lena (Solutions): I can do an architecture review session tomorrow 10:00am PT. Proposed agenda: 1) network topology & flow (PrivateLink vs Peering) 2) auth & KMS flow for Marketplace provisioning 3) SKU mapping & perf plan 4) rollout & rollback plan. Samir — can you confirm SI engineer will join and share CIDR blocks + prefix lists beforehand?

Samir (Partnerships): Pinged the SI and asked for CIDRs. SI confirmed engineer @CobaltEng will join. Diagram above has CIDRs and TGW attachment IDs.

Riley (Eng): Notes for the arch review — checklist items: 
- Ensure prefix lists and route table entries are explicit (no 0.0.0.0/0 crossings)
- Security group egress only to customer prefixes for model serving endpoints
- MTU: if they use jumbo frames, set ENI MTU=8951 and ensure encapsulation doesn't exceed path MTU
- Autoscaler: add a network policy so autoscaler health checks don't require additional open ports across accounts
- KMS: customer-managed key requires a cross-account grant; validate IAM principal used by our provisioning flow

Riley (Eng): Also recommend a short terraform snippet they can use to establish peering & route tables. Paste below for quick review:
```terraform
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-0cobalt"
  vpc_id      = "vpc-0redwood"
  auto_accept = false
}
resource "aws_route" "to_peer" {
  route_table_id         = "rtb-0redwood-public"
  destination_cidr_block = "10.20.0.0/16"
  vpc_peering_connection_id = aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer.id
}
```

Samir (Partnerships): Can we get a canary deploy of the marketplace connector into a dedicated test env that mirrors their infra? @deploy-bot schedule please. Customer wants to run provisioning flow from Marketplace and validate VPC handshake and KMS grant.

deploy-bot: Canary created -> marketplace-connector-v2 to cluster dedicated-cobalt-test. Status: queued. ETA: ~18m. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/7821

Lena (Solutions): Good. During the arch review I'll also document fallback: if peering fails, use PrivateLink + NAT setup for the provisioning calls. That avoids cross-account route complexity but requires a small proxy inside the customer's account.

Noah (Customer Success): If we can confirm weekend testing and a light rollback plan, customer will accept. Please share a minimal playbook we can send to the SI after the call.

Riley (Eng): I can spin up a dedicated node with a g4dn-equivalent profile in the test cluster and run a 1-hour load test (KV cache warmup + 2 concurrent inference streams). Will post results here.

Samir (Partnerships): Thanks all — confirming arch review tomorrow 10:00am PT and test window Saturday 02:00am PT (block for engineering). SI engineer invited. I'll drop the diagram + CIDR link in the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
